# Release model {#release-model}

Kailash versions by **release train and lock**, not by date-derived
package versions:

- Release names follow `YYYY.NN` — `2026.01`, `2026.02` — where NN
  counts releases within the year; a train may GA after the calendar
  page turns and keeps its name.
- Cuts are staged: `2026.01-alpha.1` → `-rc.1` → bare `2026.01` (GA).
  A bare number is reserved for GA; pre-GA cuts carry their suffix.
- A material re-cut of a GA in the same month is `2026.01.1`.

Every release cut is gated by a standing checklist — residue sweep of
open lanes, both repositories eval-clean, manifest validation, VM
acceptance evidence, a lock-bump release PR whose body is the release
review, and reference-hygiene checks — all recorded on the cut issue.
The lock-bump PR lands before the signed tag; verification at the tag
runs a cache pull and records validator output in the release notes.
